thread:
maria: Quick ops question — who can flip the `feature_x_enable` flag for eu-region tomorrow 02:00 UTC? Planning a slow ramp to 20% over 10 min. Need smoke checks and rollback steps prepped. :spiral_calendar:

alex: I can own the flip but I'm out 02:30-03:30 UTC. I can do the initial 0->5% and handover to raj for the 5->20% bump.

maria: Perfect. Can you post the exact commands you'll run and the smoke checklist so the oncall team can watch?

alex: Yep. Commands (internal FF service):
```
# set to 5% for EU tenants
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/flags/feature_x_enable -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' -d '{"region":"eu","percent":5}'
# bump to 20%
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/flags/feature_x_enable -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' -d '{"region":"eu","percent":20}'
# rollback to safe-default (off for eu)
curl -X POST https://infra-api.internal/flags/feature_x_enable -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' -d '{"region":"eu","percent":0}'
```

alex: Smoke checklist (10m window after each change):
- verify 200/200 on /health for eu-edge (SLO dashboard)
- run sample generation test for 10 tenants (script below)
- check error rate < 0.5% on reqs to runtime for feature_x
- watch latency p50/p95 on EU serving pool
- ensure no model fallback and no kv-cache misses spike

sophia: I can run the sample generation tests and confirm results in the thread. Which script do you want me to use?

alex: Use `tools/qa/run_sample_gen.sh --region eu --tenants-file tmp/tenants_eu.txt` — it posts results to #eng-platform-ci by default. Paste a summary here.

raj: I'll be oncall at that time and can take the 5->20% bump. I'll also be ready to execute rollback. Can someone ensure the kill-switch playbook is fresh?

maria: @sophia / @sam can you verify the kill-switch doc is up-to-date and that the runbook has the right links to dashboards + alert runbooks?

sam: I reviewed the kill-switch last week. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kill-switch. Quick summary in case dashboards are slow: rollback is the same curl to set percent=0, then force traffic to fallback pool with the router cmd:
```
# force immediate fallback for eu
ssh router-admin@router-eu -- "route set /feature_x fallback_pool"
```
I'll update the runbook to include the FF curl examples.

raj: I'll add a short watch checklist too:
- confirm sample gen pass (sophia)
- no spikes in 5xx or throttle errors
- queue depth for inference workers stable
- CPU/GPU util not > 85% for >5m
- if anything suspicious, rollback immediately and ping #incidents

maria: Timing plan: 02:00 UTC 0->5% (alex) -> monitor 10m -> 02:15 UTC 5->20% (raj) -> monitor 15m -> decision to continue or rollback. If rollback, document root cause and open a postmortem ticket.

alex: I'll post a deploy-bot annotate when I start and mark timestamps. deploy-bot, please post the flip event to the thread when you see the curl change.

deploy-bot: noted — will log flag changes and emit a message with the change diff.

sophia: I'll be ready to paste sample outputs. Anything else we need preflight?

maria: One more: set safe-defaults for new sessions (force server-side default behavior) in case KV cache misses increase. Config key is `feature_x_safe_default=on` and can be toggled separately. Alex — please don't change that during the window unless we explicitly call it.

alex: ack. I won't touch safe-defaults.

raj: ok team — I'm set to take the second bump and execute rollback if needed. I'll post final sign-off after 02:40 UTC. :thumbsup:
